items.item:
4. After a session ends the store holds no record of it: neither its set, its
   active project, its pending request nor its access version.
   Shows A11-1. [witness: verification:registry_a11_ended_session_leaves_no_record]
statements: end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1

quotes: assert by_kernel not in listed and by_owner not in listed
verdicts.why: The check accepts both kernel- and owner-ended sessions, verifies that neither ended identity remains anywhere in the session table, and detects non-registration through refused access, failed owner lookup, and absence from the session list. The surviving row is also verified to belong only to the living session.
